page_title: FIO 2-2 NAP | Fiorentina v Napoli 17/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

90+5' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Napoli.
90+4' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Frank Anguissa and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
87' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) replaces Arthur Melo.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) will replace Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
86' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
84' Yellow card. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
84' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Meret comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' The Fiorentina players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Matteo Marchetti. NO PENALTY!
81' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Fiorentina, he's going to review using VAR.
80' Referee Matteo Marchetti sees the trip by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee gives a penalty kick to Fiorentina!!
78' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Cristiano Biraghi is replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
78' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) in, Lucas Beltran out.
78' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
78' The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
76' Here is a change. Matteo Politano is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
76' Here's the change. Giovanni Simeone leaves the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
76' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
75' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

74' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the roof of the net but is denied by Alex Meret, who pulls off a glorious save! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
74' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and signals a foul after Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) brought his opponent down. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
70' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
68' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
67' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) replacing M'Bala Nzola.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Christian Kouame cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' A great pass puts Matteo Politano (Napoli) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
63' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' The game is interrupted now, Leo Ostigard (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
57' 2 - 2 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!
56' Poor challenge! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is penalised for tripping and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Napoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
53' A poor mid-range free-kick by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
51' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) covers his face with hands! He produces a header from inside the box, but the ball floats just over the bar. What a chance that was to score from a rebound!
50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), comes to nothing.

49' What a sweet touch by Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him! The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
47' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
44' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia receives a sweet cross inside the box from Matteo Politano (Napoli), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

42' 2 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:1.
41' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' 1 - 1 Superb goal! Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) again proved his ability to execute a free kick! His shot just floated in, grazing the post on the way, and gave the keeper no chance!
38' Handball by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli). Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
38' A cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
36' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
35' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
32' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret is alert and denies him.
32' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) sends a long ball in, but Alex Meret comfortably gathers the ball.
30' A cross into the box from Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is cleared.
30' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. The ball is out of play. Napoli will take a throw-in.
26' Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

25' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
24' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
24' Rough tackle by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matteo Marchetti no option but to blow his whistle.
18' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' The ball is cleared after M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

14' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
12' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
12' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
10' Half-chance! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Alex Meret reacts well to snuff out the attack.

8' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Politano sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) and his precise header from around the penalty spot went into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
7' Matteo Politano (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
3' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Meret, who smothers the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is the one to supervise the game today.
